capture_scope: all canonical tracked:<id> fired impulse_buy snapshots matched to tracked_signals; no UI cutoff, status, policy, or entry-date exclusion
statement_snapshot: single SQL statement; statement_timestamp() and MVCC snapshot
taker_metric_semantics: Persisted spot/futures taker columns are net-buy percentages: (buy volume - sell volume) / (buy volume + sell volume) * 100; these are not buy-share percentages.
missing_absolute_futures_24h_volume: No absolute futures 24h volume field is exported or inferred.

path_notes.hit_times: 15m bar open and bar close are approximate threshold times; same-bar target/stop overlaps are explicitly flagged
path_notes.coverage_rule: all expected aligned buckets from ceil(entry,15m) through floor(entry+horizon,15m)-15m; valid OHLC; zero invalid or duplicate bars; exact endpoints
path_notes.preclose_rule: separate tracker closed_at-bounded path for non-cancelled closed rows; not evidence of a fill
path_notes.closed_bar_filter: open >= detected_at; open + 15m <= horizon endpoint and capture asof

json_window_array_schema.bar_index_anchor: Each index is the 15-minute open-time bucket offset from floor(detected_at UTC / 15m); close index = open index + 1. NULL means no observation.

quality_flag_note: Large entry-anchored candle moves (including symbol redenominations/discontinuities) are flagged, never silently dropped.
data_guardrails: Every tracked fire joins exactly one canonical event_key tracked:<id> fired impulse_buy snapshot.
Entry metrics are read only from immutable snapshot.entry_metrics; missing values remain null and are not filled from mutable tracker metrics.
Entry basis is positive original_entry_price, otherwise current entry_price; basis source is recorded.
No statuses, policies, dates, UI cutoffs or rows were excluded.
No market data was fetched; forward paths use only frozen production pattern_backfill_candles.
Forward paths are OHLC observations, not evidence of fills or executable prices.
